name: 环保（材料/标准/检测）控制

map.输入室内装修材料环保等级参数，按GB 18580-2017等标准判定材料环保等级: Enter interior-decoration material eco-grade parameters to judge the material's eco grade (E0/E1/E2) per standards such as GB 18580-2017.
map.人造板 / 木地板（按甲醛释放量分级）: Wood-based panels / wood flooring (graded by formaldehyde emission)
map.：≤0.025 mg/m³ → E0 级（优等）；≤0.050 mg/m³ →: : ≤0.025 mg/m³ → Grade E0 (excellent); ≤0.050 mg/m³ → Grade E1 (qualified, usable indoors directly); ≤0.124 mg/m³ → Grade E2 (indoor only, must be surface-finished before use); >0.124 mg/m³ → unqualified, prohibited for indoor decoration.
map.：VOC ≤30 g/L 且 苯系物 ≤10 mg/kg → 优等品；VOC ≤: : VOC ≤30 g/L and benzene-series ≤10 mg/kg → premium; VOC ≤80 g/L and benzene-series ≤50 mg/kg → qualified; otherwise unqualified.
map.：VOC ≤50 g/L 且 苯系物 ≤5 mg/kg → 优等品；VOC ≤1: : VOC ≤50 g/L and benzene-series ≤5 mg/kg → premium; VOC ≤100 g/L and benzene-series ≤50 mg/kg → qualified; otherwise unqualified.
map.：涂料与胶粘剂为「同时满足」逻辑 —— VOC 与苯系物任一项超限即整体降级；人: : Coatings and adhesives use an "all must satisfy" logic—if either VOC or benzene-series exceeds its limit the whole item is downgraded; panels and flooring are judged only by the formaldehyde-emission band. The limits in the table are the tool's built-in reference basis; formal acceptance must rely on reports from a qualified testing agency.
map.📚 深度解析：室内环保控制（材料/标准/检测判定）: 📚 Deep Dive: Indoor Eco Control (Material / Standard / Test Judgment)
map.装修选材时，按 GB 50325 限值预判板材、油漆、胶粘剂、地板的污染物是否达: When selecting materials, use the GB 50325 limits to pre-judge whether panels, paint, adhesives, and flooring meet pollutant limits.
map.完工后对照检测结果判断是否超标，决定通风时长或治理方案。: After completion, compare against test results to decide ventilation duration or remediation.
map.板材 0.05、油漆 0.06、胶粘剂 0.08、地板 0.07 mg/m³，对: Panels 0.05, paint 0.06, adhesive 0.08, flooring 0.07 mg/m³, against the Class I limit 0.08: adhesive just meets it (=0.08), the rest are below the limit; overall qualified but adhesive has the least margin and needs attention.
map.0.50 mg/m³（I 类 TVOC 限值），达限即临界；>0.50 判超标，: 0.50 mg/m³ (Class I TVOC limit): reaching it is borderline; >0.50 is over-limit—suggest longer ventilation or activated-carbon/fresh-air treatment then retest.
map.指 GB 50325 中 I 类民用建筑甲醛浓度限量 0.08 mg/m³（II: It is the GB 50325 Class I civil-building formaldehyde concentration limit of 0.08 mg/m³ (Class II is 0.10). Material test values should be below the corresponding class limit to keep margin.
map.达标了为什么还建议通风？: If it passed, why still ventilate?
map.多种材料叠加会使室内综合浓度升高；单材料达标不代表房间整体达标，入住前仍建议通风: Stacking multiple materials raises the room's combined concentration; a single material passing does not mean the room as a whole passes, so ventilate and retest the combined value before moving in.
map.人造板甲醛释放量按GB 18580-2017干燥器法检测，E0≤0.025mg/: Wood-based panel formaldehyde emission is tested by the GB 18580-2017 desiccator method; E0≤0.025 mg/m³, E1≤0.050 mg/m³
map.内墙涂料VOC限值按GB 18582，优等品≤80g/L，合格品≤120g/L: Interior-wall-coating VOC limits per GB 18582: premium ≤80 g/L, qualified ≤120 g/L
map.胶粘剂有害物质限值按GB 18583，苯≤5g/kg，甲醛≤1g/kg: Adhesive hazardous-substance limits per GB 18583: benzene ≤5 g/kg, formaldehyde ≤1 g/kg
map.E2级材料必须经过饰面处理方可限室内使用: Grade E2 material must be surface-finished before limited indoor use
map.建议选择E0/E1级材料用于儿童房、卧室等长时间停留空间: It is recommended to choose E0/E1 materials for children's rooms, bedrooms, and other long-stay spaces
map.室内装修材料环保等级判定工具，输入甲醛释放量、VOC含量、苯系物含量等参数，按国: An indoor-decoration-material eco-grade judgment tool: enter formaldehyde emission, VOC content, benzene-series content, etc., and judge the material's eco grade (E0/E1/E2) per national standards.
map.支持人造板/涂料/胶粘剂/地板四类材料: Supports four material types: wood-based panels / coatings / adhesives / flooring
map.依据GB 18580等国家标准: Based on national standards such as GB 18580
